data.case_title: Apartment handover appointment after cancellation of rental Am Mühlbach 2
data.title: Handover appointment for the apartment after your cancellation to 31 March 2025
data.summary: Beispiel Immobilienverwaltung GmbH confirms receipt of the tenant's cancellation (Kündigung) of 20 December 2024, effective 31 March 2025, and proposes an apartment handover (Wohnungsabnahme) appointment on Saturday, 15 March 2025 at 09:30 at the apartment door.
data.explanation: Your landlord's property manager confirms your notice to end the tenancy on 31 March 2025 and suggests meeting on 15 March 2025 at 09:30 in front of the apartment door to hand back the flat. Bring all five keys and be ready to read the meter readings together. The apartment must be returned broom-clean (besenrein) and without any fixtures that were not there when you moved in. If the proposed date does not suit you, contact the property manager to arrange another one.
